headline: Prismana Snapshots
title: Prismana Snapshots | Photo Event Until November 29 | Aniimo Guide
video_script: A new photo event is coming to Aniimo. Prismana Snapshots runs from November twelfth to November twenty ninth, and the goal is to capture pictures of Prismana Aniimo. Prismana forms are special rare versions with a second element and their own attacks. So keep your camera ready and learn where they appear. Which Prismana will you snap first? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Prismana Snapshots event: November 12 to November 29, capture pictures of Prismana Aniimo. Checked on Game8 and AllThings.How, Nov 2026.
